name: progress
description: A progress panel beside the chat (Phases, Tests, Learn and Releases tabs, plus a few games), in your choice of colour scheme and see-through. Learn builds courses from free videos and docs with your own Claude. On Windows + WSL2 + WezTerm it floats over the window; on macOS it floats over the terminal; anywhere else it's a Claude Code pane, and Learn and the games open in your browser.
